title: Papal legates excommunicate the Patriarch of Constantinople
summary: Cardinal Humbert placed a bull excommunicating Patriarch Michael Cerularius on the altar of Hagia Sophia, and the patriarch answered by excommunicating the legates.
reason: Rome and Constantinople had long disagreed over papal authority, the Creed and church customs.
significance: It is the traditional date of the split between the Catholic and Orthodox churches.
